Question
========
A document has a top-level heading (`#`), containing a section (`##`), which itself contains a subsection (`###`).
With `number-sections: true` set in the YAML header, how would the subsection be numbered?

Answerlist
----------
* `1`
* `1.1`
* `1.1.1`
* Subsections are not numbered, only top-level headings are.

Solution
========

Answerlist
----------
* Wrong: `1` would be the number given to the top-level heading, not the subsection.
* Wrong: `1.1` would be the number given to the section, one level up from the subsection.
* Correct: numbering reflects the full heading hierarchy, so the subsection nested two levels deep is numbered `1.1.1`.
* Wrong: `number-sections: true` numbers all heading levels, not just the top level.
